mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential demand, which typically precedes increased corporate earnings and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days as construction activity drives consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When annual inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate rate hikes and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in recession risks.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in GDPC1 does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative response to inflation, which typically leads to positive equity returns over the next 60 days as the market perceives Fed actions as growth-supportive.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock recovery periods, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy recovers from supply constraints.
failure_condition: In supply shock recovery periods, a rebound in INDPRO does not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.
